summary.name: Spicetify
summary.one_liner: Spicetify is an open-source command-line tool for customizing the Spotify desktop client with themes, extensions, and custom apps.
use_cases: Apply a custom color scheme or layout to Spotify
Add keyboard shortcuts and playback controls to Spotify
Add custom pages such as lyrics or stats inside Spotify
Back up, restore, and update Spotify modifications from the command line
summary.what_it_does: Spicetify is a command-line tool that modifies the Spotify desktop client. It lets users apply community-made themes that change colors, layouts, and visuals. Extensions add keyboard shortcuts, playback controls, and integrations with other services. Custom apps add new pages inside Spotify, such as lyrics or stats. The CLI handles applying, backing up, restoring, and updating these changes. The page links to install scripts for PowerShell and shell.
notable: Community marketplace with 200+ themes, extensions, and custom apps
Powerful CLI to apply, backup, restore, and update changes
One-line install scripts for PowerShell and shell
Open source with 22k+ GitHub stars and 18M+ downloads
caveats: Modifies the Spotify client, so it may break after Spotify updates
Platform support beyond the install scripts is not stated on the page
